# Urda Anvil

> Tools, settings, rules, and software that Urda uses to build with LLMs.

Urda Anvil is a collection of tools, settings, prompts, and software that Urda
uses to build software with LLMs. The anvil.urda.com site documents that
workbench. It lists the models on the anvil, the default MCP servers and their
tool permissions, the rules the anvil gives its agents, and a set of bookmarks.

Forged Status Line is a two-row status line for Claude Code. The top row shows
the model and the modes. The bottom row shows gauges for context use and for
the 5-hour and 7-day rate limits. The renderer is a bash script that uses jq,
under the Apache 2.0 license.

## Pages

- [Models](https://anvil.urda.com/forge/balancing-the-anvil/): Models on the anvil
- [MCP servers](https://anvil.urda.com/forge/mcp/): Default servers and tool permissions
- [Rules](https://anvil.urda.com/forge/rules/): Agent rules in plain Markdown, with a raw file for each
- [Bookmarks](https://anvil.urda.com/bookmarks/): Tools and reference links
- [Forged Status Line](https://anvil.urda.com/forged-statusline/): A status line for Claude Code, with a demo and gallery

## Rules

- [ste.md](https://anvil.urda.com/forge/rules/raw/ste.md): Simplified Technical English, always-on

## Optional

- [Styleguide](https://anvil.urda.com/styleguide/): Design system for the site
- [Site README](https://github.com/urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io/blob/master/README.md): How the anvil.urda.com site is built
- [urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io](https://github.com/urda-anvil/urda-anvil.github.io): Source for anvil.urda.com
- [urda/forged-statusline](https://github.com/urda/forged-statusline): Source for the Forged Status Line, a status line for Claude Code
